name: Tag Soup
title: Christmas – Hunting Today's Special: Tag Soup Ornament
story: Today's special: tag soup. A hunting ornament for the hunter who came home from deer season with an unfilled tag and a story, and an easy deer camp gift exchange or stocking gift for the buddy who ate it again this year.

The print is a deer in a tall white chef's hat holding a green ladle over a big striped bowl of soup, with an orange hunting tag floating in it and steam curling up beside him. TODAY'S SPECIAL runs above him in orange and TAG SOUP below in big cream capitals, on a dark military green disc.
It matches our Today's Special: Tag Soup hoodie and the tag soup sweatpants, so the tree, the truck mirror and the deer camp wall can all carry the same joke.
joke_a: Tag soup is what hunters call a season that ends with the tag still in the pocket, so the deer in the chef's hat serves it up as the special of the day. This hunting ornament from Graphic Tees Co. hangs that joke on the tree or the truck mirror for any hunter who has been there.
